whatIEnjoy: Drawing, making short videos and working in a team
whatIveTried: A poster design, a short video, and a class presentation
whatImCuriousAbout: Data analysis and mobile app design

items.title: Campus Event Poster
items.description: Designed a poster for a student club event and shared it online.

reflection.whatIDid: Chose the colors and layout, and fixed the poster after feedback.
reflection.whatILearned: A clear title and good colors make a poster easier to read.
reflection.challenge: Fitting all the event details without making it crowded.
reflection.nextStep: Learn more about fonts and spacing.

items.title: Weather Data Presentation
items.description: Collected simple weather data for one month and presented it with charts to the class.

reflection.whatIDid: Collected the data, made the charts and presented them.
reflection.whatILearned: Charts help people understand numbers faster than tables.
reflection.challenge: Feeling nervous while speaking in front of the class.
reflection.nextStep: Practice presenting and try a new chart tool.
